profile.headline: Assistant Director of Web Communications at University of Washington College of the Environment
profile.summary:
I’m a designer and developer of digital projects of many scales and applications. Having worked for years on small teams in a variety of web roles, I have focused on digital strategy, user experience design, project management and front-end web development. My full suite of skills can bring a website from concept to launch with well-thought design and code.

Offline, I enjoy the whizzing of bike spokes, a fully trimmed sail and exploring the man-made and natural splendor of the Pacific Northwest.

company.name: University of Washington College of the Environment

positions.title: Web Developer and User Experience Designer
positions.description:
I work on a small marketing and communications team to build and maintain websites for the College of the Environment.

I do user testing, user experience design, responsive/mobile design, interaction design, rapid prototyping, content strategy, project management and administration on 15+ websites representing thousands of students, faculty and staff.

Technically I work with Foundation, WordPress, jQuery and these acronyms: PHP, SASS, JS, HTML5, CSS3, MySQL.

positions.title: Graphic and Web Design Specialist
positions.description: Supported the Dean’s Office in the design and creation of multiple websites, publications, and grant applications.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Enhanced a sustainability checklist for the North LINK Light Rail Project in collaboration with architecture, environmental, and engineering teams. Consolidated best practices for evaluating the sustainability of transit projects through a comparative analysis of other transit agencies.

company.name: Sound Transit, Environmental Affairs and Sustainability

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description: Provided front desk support, streamlined office administrative processes, and reduced costs. Implemented a successful student technology lab with proposal revision and $50,000 grant. Redesigned four websites. Created, and managed a social networking presence for the Program on the Environment with over 500 followers.

company.name: University of Washington, Program on the Environment

educations.fieldOfStudy: CEP, Environmental Studies, Minors in Landscape Architecture, Urban Planning

projects.title: College of the Environment Career Opportunities Page
projects.description:
LEAD DEVELOPER & DESIGNER
- Self-directed usability project, based on user popularity
- Conducted survey of existing site users, subscribers and prospective users
- User tested existing and proposed changes to site
- Enhanced filtering to paginate and update with complex queries in real-time using AJAX
- Improved design cohesion, categorization and mobile experience

projects.title: Friday Harbor Laboratories Website
projects.description:
LEAD DEVELOPER | PROJECT MANAGER
- Worked to consolidate multiple sites and strategies
- Edited, optimized and placed homepage hero video
- Developed specialized course tool
